purpose: Shows a vault picture that needs a signed request: fetches its bytes with the person's access, keeps one object URL per file until sign-out (and, if asked, a copy on the device for each person), lets only a few fetches run at once (a number the app can set), and draws a React thumbnail that loads when it nears the screen.
namedChanges: G1. pictureObjectUrl takes vaultOrigin as a second parameter in place of VAULT_ORIGIN (pictures.ts:120); the cache stays keyed by fileEntityUri only
G2. the demo branch (pictures.ts:113-114) is deleted
G3. imports: dpopReadAuth from lws-session-bridge; entityIdTail and fileIdFromPhotoRef from photo-ref
G4. Thumb is SignedImage with props vaultOrigin, placeholder (default null, replaces LeafGlyph), className (default thumb), alt (default empty); vaultOrigin is in the effect's dependency list
G5. the fetch's rejection handler becomes live && setFailed(true); the div carries data-state loading, shown or failed and draws the sentence This picture could not be loaded. when failed
F1. 0.2.0: setPictureQueueLimit(n) sets the queue limit (integer at least 1, else RangeError; default 4; raising it starts waiting jobs at once)

F2. 0.2.0: enablePictureDeviceCache({ name }) / disablePictureDeviceCache(): pictureObjectUrl reads and fills Cache Storage under the request URL (off by default; no-op without caches; storage failures swallowed with one console.warn); forgetPictures({ device: true }) also deletes that cache
the default path is the 0.1.0 code, unchanged: with none of the new functions called the unit behaves as 0.1.0

host.replaces: VAULT_ORIGIN from the app's config, src/data/pictures.ts:120

library.title: Signed picture / thumbnail from a vault
library.note: Shows a picture that needs a signed request; a public picture is a plain img. To upload take picture-upload, to shrink picture-shrink.
